sources.title: Engames: Trio compared with Nana
sources.section: What is different from Nana? Victory conditions

winCondition: Immediately win by collecting three trios, two trios whose numbers sum to 7 or differ by 7, or the trio of 7s.
notes: family: set-collection-objective. No point score or score tiebreak. Original Nana combines all three victory routes. Later Trio splits them into Simple (three trios or 7s) and Spicy (connected pair or 7s); team play is also later. Do not apply Simple mode to original Nana. Original Engames rulebook PDF still not obtained; three independent sources (publisher note, Hoobby rule page, Jelly Jelly Cafe) agree on the three victory routes and 2-5 players. Instant win, no ties.
